decisions.retain: kept as it is, moved into v1
decisions.refactor: kept in substance, rebuilt on v1 contracts
decisions.replace: a v1 component does it instead

classify_intent.note: Rules first in v0's order; one-word classifier (curriculum, general, smalltalk) only for the rest, default curriculum as in v0. generate_* intents are decided by rule, not the model.

quick_reply.note: Greetings, thanks and goodbyes answered by rule with no model call (steps greet, thanks, bye). The v0 'what is my name' answers are dropped: v1 does not hold the learner's name.

looks_like_math.note: Intent rules: an arithmetic expression, or a calculation verb with a number (number words count).

_is_lesson_request.note: Intent rule for lesson-plan requests, routed by caller.roles.

_is_question_request.note: Intent rule needs a generate verb and an assessment term (quiz, MCQ, '10 questions'); a bare 'question' no longer counts.

build_conversational_reply.note: Step chat (nexa-tutor), short reply that offers study help and asks for no personal details.

solve_simple_reasoning_question.note: A special case for one riddle ('all but N'); the general path answers it.

build_nexa_faq_answer.note: Questions about NEXA itself: publish the FAQ as an approved knowledge source instead of hard-coded matching.

infer_chat_status.note: UI status strings; v1 clients read the run status.

is_chat_turn_cancelled.note: Runs are bounded by the workflow budget (steps, agent calls, wall time). A user-initiated cancel is an open item for the client.

solve_with_sympy.note: Exact arithmetic through the calculator tool (M3-004). Symbolic algebra and calculus are not covered yet.

llm_to_sympy.note: The model writes only the expression (step extract); the tool computes it; a bad expression is refused and the question goes to the curriculum.

normalize_math_input.note: The calculator tool validates its own input.

retrieve_curriculum_context.note: Knowledge Service grounded answer with evidence status and citations (M2); the v0 index is deprecated (M2-010).

_material_covers_topic.note: Evidence levels (grounded, grounded_weak, no_evidence) from the Knowledge Service decide the route.

curriculum_answer_is_evasive.note: Grounding check in the Knowledge Service; route evidence.

strip_curriculum_meta.note: The Knowledge Service writes the cited answer; general answers are labelled instead of hiding their source.

_clean_pdf_artifacts.note: Cleaning happens at ingestion (M2-002), not at answer time.

parse_lesson_request_scope.note: Course and grade scope come from the request context and the LMS (M2-005, M2-007).

strip_output_format_noise.note: Only needed because v0 retrieved on the raw message including 'in PDF format'.

answer_with_history.note: Agent steps with a governed prompt per workflow. Conversation history in prompts becomes declared session keys (M3-006) in the M4 tutor.

build_role_instruction.note: Audience is part of each agent's manifest and each workflow's prompt.

wrap_bare_latex.note: Presentation: belongs to the client renderer, not the orchestrator.

hydrate_session_history.note: Session state (M3-006): owner-scoped, declared keys, expiry; no transcript replay from MySQL.

record_chat_turn.note: Session writes declared by the workflow (M3-006).

get_recent_turns_text.note: Declared session keys instead of raw recent turns.

resolve_followup_message.note: Follow-up rewriting from raw history; to be rebuilt on session keys in the M4 tutor.

is_conversation_meta_question.note: Questions about the conversation need a stored transcript; v1 keeps none by design (M3-006, M3-008).

looks_like_new_request.note: Multi-turn clarification becomes session state of the M4 agents, not in-memory dicts.

capture_user_fact.note: Writes learner facts to user_memory.json (learner data, open security item, M2-010).

persist_chat_log.note: Pseudonymous traces and audit (M3-008); the MySQL chat log with emails and text is not carried over.

infer_access_role.note: Role from the signed identity token (M1), not the e-mail domain; caller.roles in routes.

normalize_email_address.note: v1 does not identify users by e-mail.

fetch_page_text.note: URL reading is not in M3: it needs a web connector with an allowlist through the Tool Gateway.

build_answer_pdf.note: PDF export becomes a tool or a client feature.

_generate_lesson_and_finish.note: Lesson plans: the M4 lesson-planning agent (course_outline and knowledge_answer tools, teacher review). Until then teachers get the reviewed Lesson explainer.

extract_lesson_spec_llm.note: Lesson spec as the M4 agent's structured input.

next_missing_lesson_slot.note: Clarifying questions as session state of the M4 agent.

build_lesson_request.note: Structured input of the M4 agent.

topic_from_material.note: M4, with uploaded material through a governed document tool.

generate_lesson_plan_grounded.note: Grounded generation in the M4 agent.

generate_lesson_plan_from_text.note: M4, with uploaded material through a governed document tool.

generate_lesson_plan_direct.note: Ungrounded lesson plans are not carried over.

normalize_lesson_plan_format.note: Output contract of the M4 agent.

_generate_questions_and_finish.note: Assessment questions: the M4 assessment agent, grounded in the syllabus, teacher-reviewed.

extract_question_spec_llm.note: Structured input of the M4 assessment agent.

generate_questions_grounded.note: Grounded generation in the M4 assessment agent.

generate_questions_from_text.note: M4, with uploaded material through a governed document tool.

generate_questions_direct.note: Ungrounded question sets are not carried over.

looks_like_question_set.note: Output validation of the M4 assessment agent.

looks_like_model_refusal.note: Invalid and empty agent answers are errors (M3-009).

_handle_image_generation.note: Image generation is not carried over: no governed image model, and it served minors without review.

SESSION_PENDING_LESSON.note: Session state of the M4 lesson-planning agent.

SESSION_PENDING_QUESTION.note: Session state of the M4 assessment agent.

SESSION_DOCUMENT_BUFFER.note: Uploaded documents in process memory; uploads come back in M4 through a document tool with data handling.

POST /chat.note: The migrated router, authenticated, traced, budgeted.

POST /api/chat-stop.note: Budgets bound every run; a user cancel is an open client item.

POST /upload.note: Uploads return in M4 with a document tool and data handling.

POST /read-url.note: Needs a web connector through the Tool Gateway.

POST /api/chat-log.note: Chat logs with e-mails and text are not carried over (learner data).

POST /api/chat-rating.note: Answer feedback as a governed event in M4 (pseudonymous).

POST /api/share-chat.note: Public share links of learner chats are not carried over.

GET /api/chat-sessions/{user_email}.note: Listing by e-mail address without authentication.

GET /.note: v0 web page; clients are the Moodle plugin and EduNeX apps.
